name: @cyd-prc/dsh-entropy-guard
description: Gear-based autonomy governor for the DeepSeek Harness agent: the entropy-sdk EntropyRuntime core (gear ladder G0-G4, utility gate, slow-up/fast-down policy, tamper-evident audit chain) bound to the Harness tool registry, with a live Web UI and paper-ready metrics export.
author: Wang Miaosheng (https://orcid.org/0009-0003-2767-2421)

meta.title: Entropy Guard
meta.description: Gear-based autonomy governor: every tool call passes a utility gate under a five-level gear ladder, autonomy is earned by clean cycles and revoked on instability, and every decision lands in a tamper-evident audit chain you can export as paper-ready metrics.
